findings.suggested_fix: Use a proper prototype: change `void usage()` to `static void usage(void)` (and ensure declaration matches definition).
Modernize function signature to ANSI C style with explicit parameter list (e.g., `(void)` for no parameters).

findings.message: fatal error: glib.h: No such file or directory
findings.suggested_fix: Install GLib development headers and/or add correct include flags from pkg-config (e.g., `pkg-config --cflags glib-2.0`).

findings.message: ISO C does not permit named variadic macros (args...) [-Wpedantic]
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite variadic macros using standard C99 `...` and `__VA_ARGS__`.

findings.message: ISO C forbids braced-groups within expressions `({ ... })` used by macro FAIL [-Wpedantic]
findings.suggested_fix: Replace statement-expression macro with a `do { ... } while (0)` macro or an inline function returning an error code.

findings.message: local variable `task` shadows a global declaration [-Wshadow] (repeated many times)
findings.suggested_fix: Rename either the global `task` object or local `task` variables to avoid shadowing (or reduce scope of the global).

findings.message: function declaration isn’t a prototype / old-style function definition (e.g., new_task())
findings.suggested_fix: Use proper prototypes: `static <ret> new_task(void)` etc., and add forward declarations in a header if these are intended to be used externally.
Add a prototype in an appropriate header (or mark function `static` if it is internal to the translation unit).
Add a prototype (or mark `static` if internal).

findings.message: conversion from ‘int’ to ‘char’ may change value [-Wconversion] (e.g., `temp[o++] = match;`)
findings.suggested_fix: Make types explicit and safe: ensure `match` is within signed/unsigned char range or cast via `unsigned char` with validation.
